title: Aoristus Passīvus
subtitle: Aoristus passīvus (θη-fōrmātiō): λύω → ἐλύθην, fōrma prōrsus distīncta ā mediō — hīc dēmum media et passīva vērē dīvergunt.
objectives: Coniugāre plēnē aoristum passīvum verbī λύω (ἐλύθην)
Recordārī hoc est locus ubi media et passīva, morphologicē identica in praesentī/imperfectō/futūrō mediō (Gradibus II/III), fīnāliter DĪVERGUNT
Identificāre signum characteristicum θη (vel η, prō quibusdam verbīs: aoristus passīvus “secundus”)

content.intro: Gradus II docuit: media et passīva sunt IDENTICA in praesentī/imperfectō. Gradus III addidit: futūrum medium ≠ futūrum passīvum (fōrmae iam distīnctae, sed illud futūrī passīvī ipsum nōn adhūc vīsum). Hodiē, in aoristō, vidēs fīnāliter fōrmam passīvam vērē propriam: ἐλύθην, cōnstrūcta cum signō θη, prōrsus distīncta ā fōrmā mediā ἐλυσάμην.
content.explanation: Aoristus passīvus adhibet thema + θη + dēsinentiae speciālēs (quae sunt, historicē, dēsinentiae āctīvae, nōn mediae! — attentiō magna hīc). Discrīmen sēnsūs ā mediō (Gradū II) manet idem quam semper: passīvum = subiectum patitur āctiōnem ab aliō; medium = subiectum agit in/prō sē ipsō.

rules.heading: a) Aoristus Passīvus: ἐλύθην
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªἐλύθηνἐλύθημεν
2ªἐλύθηςἐλύθητε
3ªἐλύθηἐλύθησαν

Fōrmātiō: augmentum + thema + θη + dēsinentiae (-ν, -ς, -∅, -μεν, -τε, -σαν) — hae dēsinentiae sunt HISTORICĒ āctīvae (comparā cum aoristō āctīvō themātum in -μι, quem posteā vidēbis), nōn mediae, quamquam sēnsus est passīvus. Nōn est necesse explicāre plēnē hanc irregulāritātem historicam — sōlum recognōscere patrōnum -θη- ut signum characteristicum passīvī.

rules.heading: b) Īnfīnītīvus et Agēns
rules.body: Īnfīnītīvus: λυθῆναι. Agēns passīvus (“ab aliquō”), sī explicitus, adhibet ὑπό + genetīvum, sīcut in praesentī (Gradū II): ἐλύθη ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου “solūtus est ā dominō”. Comparā trēs fōrmae nunc distīnctae verbī λύω in praeteritō/futūrō: āctīvum ἔλυσα (solvī), medium ἐλυσάμην (solvī/redēmī prō mē), passīvum ἐλύθην (solūtus sum).

rules.heading: c) Aoristus Passīvus “Secundus” (Sine θ)
rules.body: Sīcut aoristus āctīvus/medius habet duo genera (prīmus/secundus), aoristus passīvus habet variantem sine θ — “aoristus passīvus secundus” — ut in γράφω (scrībō) → ἐγράφην (scrīptus sum), nōn *ἐγράφθην. Rārior quam variāns θη, sed frequēns satis in verbīs commūnibus; dēsinentiae persōnālēs manent identicae (-ην, -ης, -η...).

examples: ὁ δοῦλος ἐλύθη ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου. — Servus solūtus est ā dominō. (aoristus passīvus, agēns explicitus)
ἐλύθημεν ἐκ τῶν δεσμῶν. — Solūtī sumus ē vinculīs. (1ª pl.)
ἐγράφη ἡ ἐπιστολή. — Scrīpta est epistula. (aoristus passīvus secundus, sine θ)
ἐβλήθης ὑπὸ τῶν πολεμίων; — Iactus/percussus es ab hostibus? (2ª sg., βάλλω → ἐβλήθην)
αἱ πύλαι ἐλύθησαν. — Portae solūtae sunt. (3ª pl.)

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere aoristum medium (ἐλυσάμην) cum aoristō passīvō (ἐλύθην), crēdēns eōs esse eandem fōrmam.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī hīc — dīversē ā praesentī/imperfectō — media et passīva DĪVERGUNT: fōrmae sunt prōrsus distīnctae in aoristō.
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen praecipuum ab omnī cōnstrūctiōne praeteritī/praesentī iam vīsā; error hīc mūtat sēnsum fundāmentāliter (“redēmī” vs. “solūtus sum”).

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre dēsinentiās mediās (-μην, -σο, -το) ad aoristum passīvum, prōdūcendō *ἐλύθημην.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī aoristus passīvus adhibet dēsinentiās speciālēs (-ην, -ης, -η...), historicē āctīvās, NŌN mediās.
commonMistakes.why: Error commūnis quia discipulus expectat “passīvum” significāre “dēsinentiās mediās”, sed nōn hīc.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere omne verbum adhibēre θ in aoristō passīvō, sine cōnsīderāre variantem “secundam” (sine θ).
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere aliqua verba frequentia (γράφω/ἐγράφην, βάλλω/ἐβλήθην... nōn, βάλλω habet θ; exemplum melius: φαίνω/ἐφάνην) adhibent aoristum passīvum sine θ.
commonMistakes.why: Sīcut aoristus āctīvus, passīvus quoque habet duo patrōnī morphologicī prō eōdem sēnsū.

exercises.title: Coniugā Aoristum Passīvum
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā aoristī passīvī.

items.prompt: Ὁ δοῦλος ___ ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου. (3ª sg. aor. pass., λύω, “solūtus est”)
Ἐγὼ ___ ἐκ τῶν δεσμῶν. (1ª sg. aor. pass., “solūtus sum”)
Αἱ πύλαι ___. (3ª pl. aor. pass., “solūtae sunt”)
Ἡ ἐπιστολὴ ___. (3ª sg. aor. pass. secundus, γράφω, “scrīpta est”)
items.explanation: Γράφω adhibet aoristum passīvum “secundum”, sine θ: ἐγράφη.

items.prompt: Sunt aoristus medius et passīvus fōrmā identicī, sīcut in praesentī?
options: nōn, hīc fīnāliter dīvergunt in fōrmā
items.explanation: Aoristus est locus praecipuus ubi media/passīva morphologicē dīvergunt.

items.prompt: Quod signum characteristicum distinguit aoristum passīvum?
items.explanation: Θη (vel η, prō variante secundā) est signum passīvī aoristī.

items.prompt: Sunt dēsinentiae aoristī passīvī (-ην, -ης, -η...) historicē mediae?
options: nōn, sunt historicē āctīvae, quamquam sēnsus est passīvus
sunt fōrmae prōrsus novae, sine praecēdente
items.explanation: Discrīmen surprēndēns sed vērum: dēsinentiae sunt āctīvae historicē.

items.prompt: Quae praepositiō + cāsus indicat agentem passīvum in aoristō, sīcut in praesentī?
items.explanation: Ὑπό + genetīvus manet identicum per omnia tempora.

items.prompt: Exsistitne variāns aoristī passīvī sine θ ("secundus")?
items.explanation: Aoristus passīvus secundus (sine θ) exsistit prō aliquibus verbīs frequentibus.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.explanation: Falsum: adhibet dēsinentiās speciālēs (-ην, -ης, -η...), historicē āctīvās.

items.statement: In aoristō, media et passīva fīnāliter dīvergunt in fōrmā, dīversē ā praesentī/imperfectō.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: aoristus est locus praecipuus huius dīvergentiae.

items.statement: Agēns passīvus in aoristō exprimitur eōdem modō ac in praesentī (ὑπό + gen.).
items.explanation: Corrēctum: cōnstrūctiō manet cōnstāns per omnia tempora.

items.statement: Omne verbum Graecum adhibet obligātōriē θ in aoristō passīvō, sine exceptiōne.
items.explanation: Falsum: exsistit variāns “secunda” sine θ prō aliquibus verbīs.

summary: Aoristus passīvus λύω: ἐλύθην, ἐλύθης, ἐλύθη // ἐλύθημεν, ἐλύθητε, ἐλύθησαν. Īnfīnītīvus: λυθῆναι.
Signum characteristicum: θη (vel η prō variante “secundā”, ut γράφω → ἐγράφην).
Dēsinentiae aoristī passīvī sunt historicē āctīvae (-ην, -ης, -η...), nōn mediae — surprēnsa notābilis.
Aoristus est locus praecipuus ubi media/passīva DĪVERGUNT morphologicē (contrā praesēns/imperfectum, identicī): ἐλυσάμην (medium) ≠ ἐλύθην (passīvum).
Agēns passīvus: ὑπό + genetīvus, cōnstāns per omnia tempora.
